page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 143 at top right. Main block: a long column of litany invocations set as lines, with a brace on the right bracketing "Ora pro nobis." and a brace on the left bracketing "Sancta Maria". Below the column, two short lines "Propitia esto / Parce nobis Domina" and "Propitia esto / Libera nos Domina". Then a list of lines "Ab omni malo ..." with a brace on the right bracketing "Libera nos Domina." and a final line "Per" at the foot right. Margin notes: "Ora pro nobis." (right), "Libera nos Domina." (right).
page.notes: Marginal braces: left brace marks "Sancta Maria"; right braces mark "Ora pro nobis." and "Libera nos Domina." The word "Per" at the foot is cut off by the edge of the braces. Show-through from the facing page is present in the margins and was omitted. Some words of the litany are faint and may be misread.
